## Où j'en suis
Postgres 17 blue/green upgrade for the analytics RDS is coded and staged on branch `noa/rds-pg17`: parameter group family derived from the major version, blue/green enabled on staging (16.4 → 17.2), prod prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false` with no plan changes. Nothing applied — plan-only, as requested. Draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 is open with the pg_partman prerequisite and dbt lock documented.

- [en-cours] Draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 awaiting review (plan only, nothing applied)
- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 on staging (16.4), then verify `run_maintenance_proc()` on `events_raw`/`events_daily`
- [prochaine-étape] Pick production window after Maya's sign-off, avoiding dbt lock (01:00–03:30 UTC)
- [essai-raté] AWS provider bumped to v6 for blue/green support — broke plan with unrelated S3 ACL/EIP changes; user pinned it to `~> 5.82.0` instead
- [essai-raté] Proposed prod cutover Sat 28 Nov 02:00 UTC with `apply_immediately = true` — rejected by user: falls inside the dbt lock, and no date until Maya signs off
- [question] Which low-traffic slot outside the dbt lock (Sat or Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC) for the prod cutover, pending Maya's sign-off
- [décision] Keep AWS provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] Prod stays disabled (`pg17_enabled = false`), no cutover date until Maya signs off, `apply_immediately = false` (source: t14)
